content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a combination of tools and technologies that allow creators to sell their digital products directly to customers, without relying on intermediaries like Gumroad or Payhip. This matters because it gives creators autonomy over their sales and payments, and allows them to keep more of their revenue. With a sovereign stack, creators can sell their products for crypto payments, using platforms like NOWPayments, which charges a fraction of the fees that conventional platforms do.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack typically consists of a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment processing platform like NOWPayments. These components work together seamlessly to enable creators to sell their digital products and receive crypto payments, without needing to worry about the underlying infrastructure. With a sovereign stack, creators can focus on what they do best: creating high-quality digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who want to take control of their sales and payments, and keep more of their revenue. It's perfect for creators who sell design assets like ebooks, templates, and fonts, and who want to reach a global audience without being limited by conventional platforms. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can sell their products to anyone, anywhere in the world, and receive crypto payments in a secure and reliable way.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks give creators autonomy over their sales and payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work together to enable creators to sell their digital products and receive crypto payments. For example, GitHub Pages provides a hosting platform for creators to showcase their products, while Cloudflare Workers provides a backend logic platform for processing payments and delivering products. NOWPayments provides a secure and reliable way for creators to receive crypto payments, with fees as low as 0.5%. This is a significant savings compared to conventional platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform and a backend logic platform. They can then integrate a payment processing platform like NOWPayments, and start selling their digital products to customers around the world. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can get instant access to all the tools and templates they need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and all 7 templates, and is worth $348 separately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates a payment processing platform like NOWPayments. This allows them to receive crypto payments and keep more of their revenue, without relying on conventional platforms that charge exorbitant fees. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between NOWPayments and Gumroad retains $921.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% fees, compared to 10% for Gumroad.

This kit includes all 6 blueprints and all 7 templates, and is worth $348 separately. To learn more and get instant access, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, integrate a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, set up a payment processing platform like NOWPayments, create a product catalog and pricing page, configure automated delivery of digital products, and test and launch the stack. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can get instant access to all the tools and templates they need to complete these steps and start selling their digital products today.
